name: build
command: npm run security:vite-env-secrets -- --strict-local && npm run build:blog && npm run build:crawlable-corpus && npm run build:sitemap && tsc && vite build

name: build:blog
command: cd blog-site && npm run build && rm -rf ../public/blog && mkdir -p ../public/blog && cp -r dist/* ../public/blog/

name: build:commodity
command: npm run security:vite-env-secrets -- --strict-local && npm run build:openapi && npm run build:agent-skills && cross-env-shell VITE_VARIANT=commodity "tsc && vite build"

name: build:desktop
command: npm run security:vite-env-secrets -- --strict-local && node scripts/build-sidecar-sebuf.mjs && node scripts/build-sidecar-handlers.mjs && tsc && vite build

name: build:energy
command: npm run security:vite-env-secrets -- --strict-local && npm run build:openapi && npm run build:agent-skills && cross-env-shell VITE_VARIANT=energy "tsc && vite build"

name: build:finance
command: npm run security:vite-env-secrets -- --strict-local && npm run build:openapi && npm run build:agent-skills && cross-env-shell VITE_VARIANT=finance "tsc && vite build"

name: build:full
command: npm run security:vite-env-secrets -- --strict-local && npm run build:openapi && npm run build:agent-skills && npm run build:blog && npm run build:crawlable-corpus && npm run build:sitemap && cross-env-shell VITE_VARIANT=full "tsc && vite build"

name: build:happy
command: npm run security:vite-env-secrets -- --strict-local && npm run build:openapi && npm run build:agent-skills && cross-env-shell VITE_VARIANT=happy "tsc && vite build"

name: build:pro
command: cd pro-test && npm ci && npm run build

name: build:tech
command: npm run security:vite-env-secrets -- --strict-local && npm run build:openapi && npm run build:agent-skills && cross-env-shell VITE_VARIANT=tech "tsc && vite build"

name: desktop:build:finance
command: npm run security:vite-env-secrets -- --strict-local && npm run desktop:check-env && npm run version:sync && cross-env VITE_VARIANT=finance VITE_DESKTOP_RUNTIME=1 tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.finance.conf.json

name: desktop:build:full
command: npm run security:vite-env-secrets -- --strict-local && npm run desktop:check-env && npm run version:sync && cross-env VITE_VARIANT=full VITE_DESKTOP_RUNTIME=1 tauri build

name: desktop:build:tech
command: npm run security:vite-env-secrets -- --strict-local && npm run desktop:check-env && npm run version:sync && cross-env VITE_VARIANT=tech VITE_DESKTOP_RUNTIME=1 tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.tech.conf.json

name: desktop:dev
command: npm run version:sync && cross-env VITE_DESKTOP_RUNTIME=1 tauri dev -f devtools

name: prebuild
command: npm run product:facts && npm run build:openapi && npm run build:agent-skills

name: product:facts
command: node --import tsx scripts/generate-product-config.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/generate-public-product-facts.mjs

name: test:e2e
command: npm run test:e2e:runtime && npm run test:e2e:full && npm run test:e2e:tech && npm run test:e2e:finance && npm run test:e2e:energy

name: test:e2e:variant-smoke
command: npm run test:e2e:variant-smoke:full && npm run test:e2e:variant-smoke:tech && npm run test:e2e:variant-smoke:finance && npm run test:e2e:variant-smoke:commodity && npm run test:e2e:variant-smoke:energy && npm run test:e2e:variant-smoke:happy

name: test:e2e:visual
command: npm run test:e2e:visual:full && npm run test:e2e:visual:tech

name: test:e2e:visual:full
command: cross-env VITE_VARIANT=full playwright test -g "matches golden screenshots per layer and zoom"

name: test:e2e:visual:tech
command: cross-env VITE_VARIANT=tech playwright test -g "matches golden screenshots per layer and zoom"

name: test:e2e:visual:update
command: npm run test:e2e:visual:update:full && npm run test:e2e:visual:update:tech

name: test:e2e:visual:update:full
command: cross-env VITE_VARIANT=full playwright test -g "matches golden screenshots per layer and zoom" --update-snapshots

name: test:e2e:visual:update:tech
command: cross-env VITE_VARIANT=tech playwright test -g "matches golden screenshots per layer and zoom" --update-snapshots

name: test:sidecar
command: node --test src-tauri/sidecar/local-api-server.test.mjs src-tauri/open-url-safety.test.mjs api/_cors.test.mjs api/_session.test.mjs api/_api-key.test.mjs api/_user-api-key.test.mjs api/_rate-limit.test.mjs api/_sentry-common.test.mjs api/bootstrap-auth.test.mjs api/wm-session.test.mjs api/product-catalog.test.mjs api/youtube/embed.test.mjs api/cyber-threats.test.mjs api/usni-fleet.test.mjs api/rss-proxy.test.mjs scripts/ais-relay-rss.test.cjs scripts/ais-relay-ingestion.test.cjs scripts/ais-relay-entity-decode.test.cjs api/loaders-xml-wms-regression.test.mjs api/security/report.test.mjs
